title: Planet Labs PBC Q2 fiscal 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At July 31, 2026, Planet reported USD 415.1 million of cash, USD 450.3 million of short-term investments, USD 753.1 million of RPO and 109% six-month net dollar retention.
summary: The new Q2 filing materially updates revenue conversion, liquidity, cash flow, capital intensity, dilution and contract-visibility evidence and requires full valuation review.
